patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Medusa only if your buying job matches “Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 highlighted, Scale $299” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Medusa's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Medusa is shaped for Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 hig whereas Tiendanube is shaped for LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS t. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Medusa and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Medusa is Headless JS commerce — MIT OSS free; Cloud Develop $29, Launch $99 highlighted, Scale $299, Enterprise custom. No GMV tax.; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Medusa (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Medusa — Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Medusa: Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX; Not a WordPress-native plugin path (see WooCommerce); Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Medusa is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Headless means you still build or buy the storefront UX · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Medusa if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
